The handbook's doctrine for this stance is to build the watchlist, not push new entries; the stance is a reading, sizing stays the PM's (1R $620 from the fund file).

Into the close: SJM needs a daily close above 134.00 on 1.4 times volume with earnings on 24 Nov; SWK's daily-close trigger has no shared line, so decide which level you accept.
